comparison.objective: Release a spring clamp and retrieve a screwdriver into a verified left-hand grasp.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp release, coordinated extraction and sustained loaded fingertip grasp.
comparison.success_condition: Tool freed and held over marker without dropping it or moving the clamp base.
comparison.reason: Although it involves releasing retention before motion, the tested ability is clamp release and extraction, not adjust-lock sequencing or response-based damper tuning. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
